acts.title: What a good area needs
text: Ask people what a perfect neighbourhood needs and the answers are always the same: a chemist, a supermarket and somewhere to drink coffee. Nobody says an airport.
“There isn’t a swimming pool in my area and I don’t care,” says Aigul, 31. “But there’s a library on the corner and there are two good cafés. That’s enough.”

Coober Pedy in Australia is a stranger case. It is very hot and it hardly ever rains, so there aren’t many swimming pools. There aren’t any theatres either. But there is an opal mine museum, and most of the houses are under the ground, because it is cooler down there.
The people who live there say the same thing as Aigul: it’s quiet, it’s safe, and there are enough shops. Nobody mentions the airport.

items.s: People usually want a chemist in their area.
People usually say an area needs an airport.

There is a library near Aigul’s home.
There are a lot of swimming pools in Coober Pedy.
There is a museum in Coober Pedy.
The houses in Coober Pedy are under the ground.

The word used before a plural in a negative: “there aren’t ___ swimming pools”.

tts: I’m so hot! I’m so happy to be at the hotel at last. Is there a swimming pool? I’d like to have a swim.
No, I’m sorry, there isn’t. It doesn’t rain a lot here, so there aren’t many swimming pools.
You mean there aren’t any swimming pools at all? — No, don’t worry! There’s a big swimming pool in the town centre if you want to go swimming. There just isn’t one at the hotel.
Are there any museums near the centre? — Yes, there are. There’s the opal mine museum.

write.q: Describe your neighbourhood: 6 sentences. Say three things there are, two things there aren’t, and what the area is like.
write.model: In my neighbourhood there’s a chemist and a small supermarket on the corner. There are a lot of cafés near the station and there’s a library two streets away. There isn’t a swimming pool and there aren’t any theatres. The street is noisy in the morning, but it’s safe and I like it.
